final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover about eventual consistency in distributed systems. A write has already succeeded, but one glowing versioned data pulse still has to propagate through replicas before every node agrees. The reader should feel a short controlled period of uncertainty followed by clear convergence.

Summary angle: One confirmed update signal crosses temporarily disconnected relay stations; an old version remains in shadow, then every replica lights up with the same state.
Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and three supporting beats.
Information blocks:
- A dim replica still holds an old version, labeled "旧数据".
- The single bright data pulse travels through a broken-looking but reconnecting path, labeled "传播中".
- Three restrained relay stations share the same color and shape after convergence, labeled "已收敛".

Main metaphor: a versioned signal pulse moving through distributed relay stations in the dark and gradually replacing the stale version.
Subject: one glowing cyan-orange data pulse at the center, moving forward and synchronizing three compact replica stations.
Composition/framing: diagonal forward movement, the central pulse is the only primary focal subject, deeper shadows on the left and clearer light on the right, wide cover illustration, aspect ratio 2.35:1.
Style/medium: combine an isometric conceptual systems scene with suspense thriller comic mood, low-key lighting, sharp shadows, uneasy framing, controlled tension without gore. Stylized, polished, editorial, and readable. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: midnight blue, signal cyan, warning orange, cool gray.
Visible text policy: render only these three Chinese labels verbatim: "旧数据", "传播中", "已收敛". No other text. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no chart axes, no architecture node names.
Constraints: one primary pulse only; no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake charts, no terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: horror characters, gore, code rain, neon city, generic robot, repeated primary pulses, dense HUD overlays.
